sections.title: Art
lines: Characters, portraits, textures, props, menu ornaments, menu icons and the title art were drawn for this game with Google Gemini (gemini-3.1-flash-image) and finished in Blender.

Spell, item and cursor icons made by Lorc, Delapouite, Skoll, Sbed, Caro Asercion, Willdabeast, Cathelineau, DarkZaitzev, Carl Olsen, Zajkonur and Faithtoken from game-icons.net, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), and by Zeromancer (CC0); framed and coloured for this game.
Controller button pictures: Input Prompts by Kenney (kenney.nl). CC0.
